title: EvalSpec — declarative evaluation specification (Blueprint B § 2.1)
description: Content-addressed via content_hash. State machine: draft → published → deprecated (deprecated reversible to published). Mutable in draft; immutable once published.

assertions.description: Typed assertion expressions. Blueprint B § 2.1 says only 'typed expression' — no class enum, no payload grammar. Element shape deferred per spec STOP directive (bd_000-projects-gzgj, Class-2 ISEDC required to enumerate).

scoring.description: Scoring configuration. aggregation_rule is the ONLY spec-bound field per Blueprint B § 2.1. § 7.6 architectural rule: thresholds belong in consumer-side tests/TESTING.md, NOT here. Additions require ISEDC review (bd_000-projects-21re).

extensions.description: Tool-specific scoring metadata. MUST NOT drive ship/no-ship decisions (mirrors § 7.4 metadata rule).

composition.description: DAG declaration per Blueprint B § 1.3. Validation contract: runtime topologically sorts; cycles rejected at submission with 400. Wire format (adjacency list with typed edges) is engineer's choice per bd_000-projects-3sjx; semantics ARE spec-bound (node types + edge kinds + failure propagation per § 1.3 line 100).

kind.description: Node type per Blueprint B § 1.3 line 92.
Edge type — drives runtime failure-propagation per Blueprint B § 1.3 line 100.

expected_artifacts.description: SkillSnapshot.combined_sha values this spec targets. Anchors on CONTENT (sha), not FK — rebuilt snapshots with the same combined_sha still satisfy.

runtime_limits.description: Resource ceilings applied per EvalRun per Blueprint B § 2.1.
